summary: Ridgetech Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held August 25, 2026. Shareholders approved election of four directors, ratification of YCM CPA as auditor, adoption of Sixth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles (creating Series A Preferred Shares and changing quorum), and a capital reduction reducing par value from US$0.15 to US$0.0001 per share. Voting tallies are provided. The filing is a routine meeting result and is not a special situation.
